plain: A person or firm that is owed money

webster.text: A person to whom a sum of money or other thing is due, by obligation, promise or in law; properly, one who gives credit in commerce; but in a general sense, one who has a just claim for money; correlative to debtor.

example.quote: Rhode Island has been in one continued train of opposition to national duties and integrity ; they have defrauded their creditors by their jiaper money.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
